transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. Well, I came in today because... I've been struggling with something at work lately. I'm a secondary school teacher, and recently, I just can't shake this feeling that certain staff emails and the morning announcements are actually coded messages about me. 

My colleagues have been very gentle about it, and they've sat down and shown me that these emails are just standard memos sent to everyone on staff, but... I just can't seem to let the feeling go. It's really starting to bother me, so I thought I should come in and talk to someone about it.
Have you been feeling unusually down or depressed recently?

No, I wouldn't say that. I haven't really felt down or sad... I mean, I'm definitely frustrated by this whole situation at work, but my mood itself has been pretty normal. It's just this one specific thing with the messages that's bothering me.
Have you had any other experiences like hearing voices that other people do not hear?

Well, yes, actually. I have been hearing something. Sometimes, when it's really quiet... like when I'm at home by myself, or right after all the students leave the classroom for the day... I hear a woman's voice. 

It's usually just my name, or maybe a short little comment about whatever I happen to be doing right then. But it's so clear that I actually answer back out loud, just automatically, before I even realize that I'm completely alone in the room.
How long have you been having these experiences with the coded messages and hearing the voice?
Well, let's see... I think it's been about four months now. Yeah, around four months since I first started worrying about the messages and hearing the voice.
Have these experiences been going on continuously for at least six months?

Well, the specific things—the messages and the voice—have only been happening for about four months. But if you mean the broader situation... yes, it's been more than six months. 

This overall change in how I think, how I'm handling my work, and just connecting with people... that's been going on for longer. I'd say that all started right around the time my youngest left for college, which was about a year and two months ago.
Have you had any periods lasting at least a week when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable, with much more energy than usual?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I definitely haven't had any bursts of energy or felt unusually high... or overly irritable for days on end. Honestly, with everything going on, I've mostly just been trying to keep up with my classes. So, no, my energy hasn't been higher than normal.
Have there been any times when the messages or the voice happened only while you were also feeling depressed?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... I haven't really noticed feeling depressed. The messages and the voice just happen on their own, regardless of how I'm feeling. It doesn't seem to be tied to my mood or feeling down at all.
Have these experiences made it harder for you to function at work or in your daily life?

Yes, it definitely has. I mean, I’m still teaching, but... I've had to rely on my coworkers a lot more. I've actually needed them to step in and cover parts of my project lessons, and they've really had to help me just get through our planning meetings. 

And outside of work, in my personal life, I've just stopped being reliable. I used to go to book club, the theater, different neighborhood events... but I just haven't been keeping up with any of that lately.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest or pleasure in things most of the day nearly every day?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I mean, I definitely haven't felt depressed or down for weeks at a time. And I haven't lost interest in things because of my mood... it's just that I haven't been going to my usual activities because of everything else that's been happening. But no, I haven't had a two-week period of feeling depressed like you described.
Have you been using any alcohol, recreational drugs, or new medications around the time these symptoms started?

No, nothing like that. I don't really drink, maybe just a glass of wine at a holiday dinner, but that's it. And I definitely don't use any recreational drugs. As for medications, I haven't started anything new recently... just my usual vitamins. So, no, nothing out of the ordinary there.
Have you noticed becoming noticeably less emotional or expressive than you used to be?

Well, yes, I suppose I have. I mean, I still care about my students, and my friends, of course. But... for many months now, it just feels like the warmth and the drive have sort of drained out of me. 

I'm just not as expressive or engaged. That's why I've let things like the book club, the theater planning, and even just simple phone calls slide. I just don't initiate anything anymore unless someone really pushes me to do it. It's just... hard to muster up the energy to react or be involved the way I used to be.
Have you ever felt that someone else was controlling your thoughts, feelings, or actions?

No, I haven't ever felt anything like that. My thoughts and my actions are my own. I mean... even though I don't have the energy to do much these days, it's definitely still me making the choice to step back from things. I've never felt like someone else was pulling the strings or controlling my mind, no.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest or pleasure in things nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say I've felt depressed. I know I just mentioned losing interest in my book club and the theater planning, but... it's not because I feel sad or hopeless. It doesn't really feel like depression. It's more just that lack of energy and warmth I was talking about. I don't sit around feeling down or crying or anything like that. So, no, I haven't had a period like you're describing.
Have the unusual messages and the voice been present for a total of six months or more?
No, not quite that long. I'd say... well, the worries about the coded messages, and that voice I sometimes answer, they've been happening for about four months now. So it hasn't been six months yet.
Have you been hearing the woman’s voice even when there’s clearly no one there?

Yes, that's right. It usually happens when it's really quiet, like when I'm alone in my house, or... or right after the students leave and the classroom is empty. I'll just hear this woman's voice. Sometimes she just says my name, or she might make a little comment about whatever I'm doing at the moment. It sounds so clear that I actually answer her out loud... and then I look around and realize there's no one else in the room.
Have the coded messages and the voice ever only happened during times when you were feeling depressed?

Well, like I said before, I haven't really felt depressed. So... no, the messages and the voice haven't been connected to anything like that. They just happen on their own, regardless of how my mood is.
Have you noticed any periods when your speech or behavior became noticeably disorganized or hard for other people to follow?

Well, yes, I have noticed some things like that. Sometimes during my lessons, or... or when I'm in meetings for the art fair, I’ll just catch myself stopping right in the middle of a task. I'll start rearranging markers or papers on the desk in a very particular pattern. 

And with my speech... sometimes I’ll just repeat a phrase someone else just said instead of responding to them normally. It’s quite embarrassing, honestly, because it completely interrupts what I’m supposed to be doing.
Have the unusual messages and the voice been present for a total of six months or more?
No, it hasn't been six months. The worries about the coded messages and... and the voice I sometimes answer, those have only been happening for about four months now.
Compared with before all of this started, has your work or day-to-day functioning gotten noticeably worse?

Yes, it has. I mean, I’m still teaching, but... I’ve actually needed my coworkers to step in and cover parts of my project lessons lately. They’ve also had to help me get through our planning meetings. And outside of school, things have slipped, too. I've pretty much stopped being reliable for my book club, going to the theater, and the different neighborhood events I usually attend. So, yes, it has definitely gotten noticeably worse.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you had these voices or beliefs even though your mood was completely normal and you were not depressed or unusually energized?

Um, no, I don't think so. I haven't really had a stretch of two weeks where I felt completely normal but still had the voices or the worries about the messages. It seems like... well, I just haven't noticed a time like you're describing where my mood was perfectly fine while all of that was going on.
